prompt:
A design-sprint storyboard drawn in Copic markers and black fineliner on white marker paper: three panels in a row, each with a short hand-lettered caption underneath. Panel 1: Two travellers at home compare separate notes about places and travel arrangements. Screen text: "Send your ideas" Caption: Everyone is planning from different information. Panel 2: On a shared phone screen, they add places, questions and useful phrases to one plan. Screen text: "Added to our plan" Caption: Their ideas come together in one place. Panel 3: At a station in China, both travellers check the shared plan. Screen text: "Next stop: Shanghai" Caption: They stay aligned while travelling.
Style: mostly white paper showing through, with light cool grey marker shading only where needed to separate planes — keep it airy. One warm orange accent on the key screen elements. Loose confident linework, a few visible marker streaks but not filled in. People are simple sketched figures with no facial detail. Any text on a screen, card or sign is short, legible and spelled exactly as given; captions are hand-lettered in neat block capitals. Feels like a real concept storyboard stuck on a workshop wall. No logos, no brand names, no watermark. The three panels and their captions fill the frame edge to edge, with only a slim paper margin.
